function: Excluded, above_phy: MADDPG allocates offloading and local-execution power to cut power and buffer length in vehicular edge computing; the RIS phases come from BCD (p. 1, p. 3).
notes: Excluded for above_phy (code 4), not no_learning (code 3), because a trained DRL model does act. The learned part is a modified MADDPG that sets the offloading power and the local execution power of each vehicle in a vehicular edge computing (VEC) system. p. 1: "algorithm to solve the power allocation for vehicle offloading" and local execution. p. 3: "The target is to minimize the power consumption of task" offloading and local processing as well as buffer length, a task offloading and edge computing decision with queue dynamics. The RIS phase shifts, the only element that belongs to area 3, are set by the classical block coordinate descent and are not learned, p. 3: "Therefore, we will first use the BCD algorithm to obtain the" optimal phase-shift. If the offloading transmit power were counted as a physical-layer decision learned jointly with the local power, the exclusion would be function (power control for offloading is not one of the seven areas), with the same decision. The PDF is arXiv 2406.11318v2 and does not print its DOI; its reference list cites LCOMM.2024.3443603 (p. 5), consistent with an LCOMM 2024 DOI. The text layer of p. 5 is unreadable, so I read p. 4 and p. 5 as page images.
